//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the KPI EDITORIAL-MINIMAL CONTAINER — the `.pa-kpi-edit` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiEditorial.kpi_editorial/1`, svelte `display/KpiEditorial.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. This is a CARD-based container (`.pa-card.pa-kpi-edit`) with a shared KPI header (`.pa-card__header.pa-kpi-header` + optional `.pa-kpi-live` LIVE pill), a zero-padding body (`.pa-card__body.pa-kpi-edit__body`) holding the tile GRID (`.pa-kpi-edit__grid` + the six `__grid--*` column-cap modifiers + an inline `--pa-kpi-edit-cell-min` density override), and an optional footer (`.pa-card__footer.pa-kpi-footer`). The grid's tile CELLS come from a SEPARATE sub-component (svelte KpiEditorialTile.svelte, keen kpi_editorial_tile/1) fed through the default slot, which BOTH dumpers pass as plain ESCAPED TEXT — so real tile markup can't materialize. This fixture proves ONLY what the container emits: the card shell, the header/live/footer slots, the body, the grid element + its column-cap modifiers + the cell-min inline style, and the class passthrough. The per-TILE element classes (pa-kpi-edit__tile / __label / __value / __num / __unit / __meta / __delta[/--variant] / __target) belong to the deferred tile sub-component and are acknowledged as prose in `deferred` (no tile fragment fixture/dumper clause exists to fixture-ref). See stacked-bar.json / fields.json for the same container-only model (container element-modifiers claimed via features, child-component element classes deferred). The shared pa-kpi-header / pa-kpi-live / pa-kpi-footer classes are NOT pa-kpi-edit__* (different block, shared KPI chrome) so axis-1's element reverse-check doesn't touch them; they still appear verbatim in the goldens.

propsVocabulary.titleText:
card header title — rendered as

…

inside .pa-card__header.pa-kpi-header. svelte `titleText`, keen `title_text`. When absent AND not live, the whole header is omitted.
propsVocabulary.live: show the LIVE pill (animated dot + 'LIVE') next to the title (.pa-kpi-live > .pa-kpi-live__dot). svelte `isLive` bool (label is the hardcoded literal 'LIVE'); keen `is_live` bool with `live_text` defaulting to 'LIVE'. The header renders if titleText OR live is set.
propsVocabulary.footerText:
footer caption text — rendered as
…
. svelte `footerText`, keen `footer_text`. When absent (and no footer slot), the footer is omitted.
propsVocabulary.gridLayout: grid column-cap modifier on the grid element — one of 2col / max-2 / max-3 / max-4 / max-5 / max-6, emitting pa-kpi-edit__grid--{value}. Default (nil) is the bare cell-min-driven auto-fit grid, no modifier. svelte `gridLayout` (dash-cased token), keen `grid_layout` (keen also has an `is_2_columns` shorthand that resolves to '2col' — same class).
propsVocabulary.cellMinWidth: CSS length written as the inline style `--pa-kpi-edit-cell-min: {value};` on the grid element (density override; upstream default 14rem). svelte `cellMinWidth`, keen `cell_min_width`. Inline style, not a class.
propsVocabulary.body: the grid's tile area — plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-kpi-edit__tile children are the deferred sub-component). svelte `children`, keen `inner_block` (required:true).
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the card (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural container only. The body slot is a plain text token (Body) so the diff checks the card shell + header/footer slots + the grid element (class/modifier/inline-style) + nesting, not rich tile content. The header is emitted ONLY when titleText or live is set; the footer ONLY when footerText (or a footer slot) is set — scenarios exercise both the present and absent forms. The cell-min inline style lands on the GRID element as style="--pa-kpi-edit-cell-min: {value};"; both wrappers serialize it identically (keen `#{width};` / svelte `${width};`). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-edit'). The .pa-kpi-edit BLOCK has ZERO block-level modifiers (no pa-kpi-edit--* exists — the column caps are ELEMENT modifiers on __grid, and the delta tints are element modifiers on the deferred __delta). So axis-1's block-modifier reverse check is vacuous for this block. CONTAINER element classes: __body (always on the card body) and __grid (+ its six __grid--* caps) are produced/exercised here; __body & __grid appear in every golden, the caps are produced by the gridLayout enum template. TILE element classes (__tile/__label/__value/__num/__unit/__meta/__delta[/--*]/__target) are the deferred sub-component (prose in `deferred`). `produces: null` = structural/native/inline-style (no class).

titleText.note: card header title text; absence (with live off) omits the whole header — structural, no class

live.note: LIVE pill (.pa-kpi-live, shared KPI chrome — not a pa-kpi-edit__* class); structural

footerText.note: footer caption; absence omits the footer — structural, no class

gridLayout.note: column-cap element modifier on __grid; default (nil) is the bare auto-fit grid

cellMinWidth.note: inline style --pa-kpi-edit-cell-min on the grid element; density override, not a class

body.note: structural — the grid's inner content; real tiles are the deferred sub-component

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the card, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-TILE element + state classes of the pa-kpi-edit block — NOT container markup. They are emitted by the SEPARATE tile sub-component (svelte KpiEditorialTile.svelte, keen kpi_editorial_tile/1) fed through the default slot, which both dumpers pass as plain escaped TEXT, so they cannot materialize here and there is NO kpi-editorial-tile fragment fixture/dumper clause to fixture-ref (a ref would DEFER?-fail). Acknowledged as prose. The __delta--* tints mirror the sentiment palette (positive/negative/neutral + up-strong/down-strong strong variants); keen author props use underscore variants (up_strong/down_strong) dasherized to the CSS class.
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__tile: tile sub-component (svelte KpiEditorialTile / keen kpi_editorial_tile) — one KPI cell (per-cell container-query host); slot-fed, no fragment fixture/dumper wiring
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__label: tile sub-component — the uppercase mono caption
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__value: tile sub-component — the thin-weight headline number row
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__num: tile sub-component — the tabular numeral inside __value
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__unit: tile sub-component — the dim prefix/suffix affix inside __value
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__meta: tile sub-component — the delta + target meta row
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__delta: tile sub-component — the coloured delta (bare class defaults to --pa-positive)
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__delta--positive: tile delta tint — keen delta_variant='positive'; out of container scope
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__delta--negative: tile delta tint — keen delta_variant='negative'; out of container scope
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__delta--neutral: tile delta tint — keen delta_variant='neutral'; out of container scope
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__delta--up-strong: tile delta tint — keen delta_variant='up_strong' (dasherized); out of container scope
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__delta--down-strong: tile delta tint — keen delta_variant='down_strong' (dasherized); out of container scope
deferred.pa-kpi-edit__target: tile sub-component — the dim 'tgt {value}' text (with inner tgt)
